The '''HK-47 Carbine''', also known as '''HK-47 blaster''', was a custom-crafted model of [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbine]] was developed during the final years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It was unusual in that it was equipped with a bio-link module that allowed the user to interface directly with the weapon during combat.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|45|HK-47 blaster}}</ref> One such weapon was owned by the droid [[HK-47]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:ToOW" />
